Client details

Key compatibility findings

The practical issues most likely to affect existing 1.12 addons.

FeatureResultEvidenceConsequence
print()SILENT / NO VISIBLE EFFECTManual observationThe binding exists and returns without an error but produces no visible output.
PlaySound()WORKINGManual observationWorking. The original checkbox sound is simply very quiet.
PlaySoundFile()MISSINGAutomated inventoryNot exposed by this client. Addons such as BugSack need a PlaySound fallback or must suppress the sound.
RunScript()FAILEDAutomated behaviour testThe binding exists and returns without an error but has no observable effect.
Error-handler APIPARTIALAutomated inventoryseterrorhandler exists, but geterrorhandler is missing. Error-catching addons need a compatibility adapter.
Event callback argumentsQUIRKCaptured eventsThe callback parameters were nil. Event names and payloads appeared in the vanilla globals event and arg1–argN.
EditBox selection/cursor APIMISSINGUI-object surveyHighlightText, SetCursorPosition and GetCursorPosition are absent, breaking normal select-all/copy interfaces.
CheckButton texture APIMISSINGUI-object surveyChecked-texture getters/setters are absent. Addons should supply or control their checkmark texture separately.
Ordinary ScrollFrame text childrenQUIRKObserved compatibility testOrdinary ScrollFrame text children did not scroll; fixed-row FauxScrollFrames work correctly.
Lua 5.1 varargs, #, %, select()VERIFIEDAutomated behaviour testsModern varargs preserve a middle nil; # returned 3 for a three-element sequence; 7 % 4 returned 3; select preserved count and nil values.
GetBuildInfo() return shapeQUIRKAutomated return-shape testThis client returned seven values (build channel, localized release label, version, build, date, internal number and platform), not the usual compact 1.12 layout.
Lua libraries io, os, packageMISSINGAutomated inventoryThe runtime identifies as Lua 5.1 but omits these standard libraries, consistent with a restricted addon sandbox.
sol2-bound UI objectsOBSERVEDGlobal userdata inventoryTwenty-seven userdata globals have sol.Azeroth::FrameUI class names, strongly indicating manually exposed C++/Lua UI bindings.
Address-bearing global namesQUIRKAutomated global inventory142 globals contain volatile process addresses, commonly appended to UI resource paths. The HTML normalizes the address portion because it changes between runs.
